Fix: offlineSignature.ts adds `importOfflineGrantKeyRing(configured)` (accepts the legacy single private JWK, or a strict `{schemaVersion:1, active:<private JWK>, previous?:{jwk:<PUBLIC JWK>, retiredAtEpochSeconds, overlapEndsAtEpochSeconds}}` document; rejects unknown fields, private previous material, duplicate kids, non-integer timestamps, overlap > OFFLINE_KEY_ROTATION_MAX_OVERLAP_SECONDS = OFFLINE_PRO_LEASE_MAX_SECONDS (7d) with `invalid_key`), `OfflineGrantKeyRing {signingKey, activeKey, previousKey|null, allowedKeyIds}`, and `verifyOfflineExecutionGrant(raw, ring | keys[], ctx)` which — after signature/claim validation — rejects a previous-key token with `retired_key` when `ctx.nowEpochSeconds >= overlapEndsAtEpochSeconds` (exclusive end) or when its `iat > retiredAtEpochSeconds` (old key cannot mint after retirement). W04-03 round 2 delivered on devin/pp/w04-03/impl-r2 @ feb7c4127a74d8fda11717721483d8f3a30d0237 (7 commits over BASE 674bcacc; no PR opened).

Defect on BASE_SHA (VERIFIED by the 12 failing regression tests): supabase/functions/api/offlineSignature.ts on BASE only exports importOfflineGrantSigningKey (single active key) and verifyOfflineExecutionGrant over a flat key list — there is no key ring, no previous-key retirement/overlap window, no retired_key outcome, and the route in index.ts binds allowedKeyIds:[signingKey.kid] only, so a receipt signed under a rotated-out key is either accepted forever (if still listed) or rejected as invalid_key immediately (if removed): no bounded overlap exists. Round-1 adversary B5 (P1): a private JWK whose x/y do not belong to d imported successfully, the route answered 200 and spent issue_offline_grant for a grant the ring itself could not verify.

Fix (all inside write_paths + the held edge-index wiring hunk):
- offlineSignature.ts: `importOfflineGrantKeyRing(document)` accepts either the legacy bare private JWK or `{schemaVersion:1, active, previous:{jwk, retiredAtEpochSeconds, overlapEndsAtEpochSeconds}|null}`; at most one previous key, public-only, overlap bounded by OFFLINE_KEY_ROTATION_MAX_OVERLAP_SECONDS = OFFLINE_PRO_LEASE_MAX_SECONDS (7 d), and overlapEndsAt > retiredAt required. B5 fix: `importSigningKeyPair` validates JWK members, checks 0 < d < n and that (x,y) satisfies the P-256 curve equation, imports both halves and signs+verifies a deterministic probe — any inconsistency is OfflineGrantCryptoError('invalid_key') before anything is spent. B6: every public JWK (active and previous) is on-curve-checked before WebCrypto import. B3: a previous entry whose (x,y) equal the active key's is refused. Verification: protected header must carry kid; a previous-key signature is accepted only when iat <= retiredAt AND now < overlapEndsAt, otherwise 'retired_key'; after removal 'invalid_key'. B1: the binding's allowedKeyIds may narrow the ring (active-only allowlist still verifies active grants). B2: retirement windows travel with the key object, so a retired key handed to the verifier as a plain list entry still expires at overlapEndsAt.
- index.ts (edge-index, held): imports the ring, caches it per distinct secret value, signs with ring.signingKey and passes ring.allowedKeyIds as the verifier-side binding allowlist; malformed configuration stays a generic 503 with zero RPC calls.
- docs/runbooks/offline-key-rotation.md: rotation procedure (mint, promote, bounded overlap, retire), import-time consistency rules, dry-import command and its verdicts; corrected the round-1 claim that grants embed allowedKeyIds (B4) — it is verifier-side binding context, not a signed claim — and pinned that by test.
